Class HonestNodeBehavior

java.lang.Object
ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.bitcoin.node.DefaultNodeBehavior
ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.bitcoin.node.HonestNodeBehavior
All Implemented Interfaces:
NodeBehaviorStrategy
Direct Known Subclasses:
HonestNodeBehaviorLimited
public class HonestNodeBehavior extends DefaultNodeBehavior
Implements the canonical ("honest") node behavior in the simulated Bitcoin network. An HonestNodeBehavior reacts to incoming transactions and blocks in a manner consistent with the Bitcoin consensus protocol—verifying, propagating, and mining without deviation or manipulation.

This class extends DefaultNodeBehavior, inheriting core Proof-of-Work and mining logic, and specializes it for an honest mining strategy. The node:

  • Receives transactions from clients and other nodes.
  • Propagates valid transactions and blocks through the network.
  • Validates mined blocks and integrates them into its local blockchain.
  • Stops and restarts mining as required by consensus conditions.

All simulation-time and reporting operations are integrated with BitcoinReporter and Simulation to allow detailed tracking of network dynamics.

Author:
Sotirios Liaskos for the Conceptual Modeling Group @ York University

      public void event_NodeReceivesClientTransaction(ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.engine.transaction.Transaction t, long time)
      Handles transactions received directly from clients.

      The transaction is accepted if it is conflict-free and all its dependencies are present. If accepted, it is added to the pool and broadcast to peers. Otherwise it is discarded and the rejection reason is logged.

    • event_NodeReceivesPropagatedTransaction

      public void event_NodeReceivesPropagatedTransaction(ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.engine.transaction.Transaction t, long time)
      Handles transactions propagated from other nodes.

      The transaction is accepted if it is conflict-free, all its dependencies are present, and it is not already in the pool or blockchain structure. If accepted, it is added to the pool and mining is reconsidered. Otherwise it is discarded and the rejection reason is logged.

      Specified by:

      Specified by:

      Parameters:

    • event_NodeReceivesPropagatedContainer

      public void event_NodeReceivesPropagatedContainer(ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.engine.transaction.ITxContainer t)
      Handles reception of a propagated block from another node.

      Logs the reception event, constructs a conflict block to check for structural conflicts, and validates the block against the local blockchain. A block is accepted if:

      • None of its transactions are already in the structure on the chain where it would be placed.
      • None of its transactions conflict with transactions already in the structure.
      • All of its transaction dependencies are satisfied by the structure.
      Accepted blocks are integrated via DefaultNodeBehavior.handleNewBlockReception(Block). Rejected blocks are logged as errors.

      Specified by:
      event_NodeReceivesPropagatedContainer in interface NodeBehaviorStrategy
      Specified by:
      event_NodeReceivesPropagatedContainer in class DefaultNodeBehavior
      Parameters:
      t - the propagated container (expected to be a Block)

    • event_NodeCompletesValidation

      public void event_NodeCompletesValidation(ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.engine.transaction.ITxContainer t, long time)
      Handles completion of block validation by this node.

      Records validation metadata, logs the event, runs a sanity check to detect unexpected overlaps with the existing structure, adds the block to the local blockchain, broadcasts a clone to peers, and triggers post-validation activities (mining pool update, mining reconsideration).
